san eva upaviśa iṣet idam svastika ākāra tayā a svastika āsanam

tat idam vīrāsanam
syāt iti arthaḥ prāṇāyāma lakṣaṇam āha iḍayā ityādinā
gamana āgamanā vāyoḥ prāṇasya dhāraṇam tathā prāṇāyāma
iti proktaḥ yoga śāstre viśāradaiḥ iti tatra kṣaṇam uktam gautamī
ye prāṇasya iti iti ṣaṣṭī tatpuruṣaḥ saca prāvāyu apara paryāyaḥ
āyāma padārthaḥ ca khechayā gati nirodhaḥ tat ca kevalaṃgama
ne kevala gamane pūraṇa rūpe gamana āgamanayoḥ dvayoḥ api ni
rodhane ca saṃbhavati iti abhiprāyeṇa pūrva ślokam vivṛṇoti ta
tatra eva gautamaḥ prāṇaḥ vāyuḥ iti khyāta āyāmaḥ tad niro
dhanam prāṇāyām iti proktaḥ yoginām yoga sādhanam iti

aṃguli sphoṭanam
kuryāt sa mātrā iti prakīrtitā iti iḍā vāmanāḍī tayā ṣoḍaśa
mātrā kāla paryyaṃtam vāyum vāhya daśā daṃtaḥ samākarṣayet
ākṛṣṭasya vāyoḥ catuḥṣaṣṭi mātra
paryaṃtam niścala tayā āsthāpanam kuryāt tat etat kuṃbhakam kuṃbha
tatas śanais dvāviṃśat mātrā kāla
paryantam pūritam vāyum niḥsārayet tat etat evanāt niḥsāra
evaṃrīti āpūraka kuṃbhaka recakā
tmakānām vāyuniyamanānām trayāṇām anuṣṭānāt ekaḥ prā
suṣumṇā madhya gam vāyum pūrva pūritam samyak
dhārayet iti pūrveṇa saṃvaṃdhaḥ
pūraka kuṃbhaka krameṇa punar punar abhyāsena dvādaśa prāṇāyā
mān ṣoḍaṣa prāṇāyāmān cakuryāt iti arthaḥ
ye bhavati yat uktam śucce prāṇāyāmān praṇava sahitān
ṣoḍaśa vaśī prabhāte sāpaṃca pratidivasam evam vitanute dvijaḥ

rtinā para vrahmaṇaḥ caitanyasya madhye sthitena para vrahma āsaktena
ti yāvat
upasaṃharati proktam iti

rabhya tatra nāḍī sthāneṣu vāyu saṃcāram vaktum sa pramāṇam śarīra
svarūpam upadarśayati ṣaṣ ityādinā agnīṣoma ātmaka tvena
śukra śoṇita ātmaka tvena vā ubhaya ātmakam śarīram sarveṣām sva aṃgulaiḥ
ṣara anavati aṃgula dīrgham bhavati tatra madhyabhāgena ābhiḥ bhavati
tra śarīre liṃga guda aṃtarāle dvi aṃgula mānena uccam catur aṃgulam
stṛtam vṛtta āram kuṃdam mūlādhāram nāma sarva nāḍī mūla tvena mūlā
dhārakaṃdām āmanaṃti tasmāt anaṃtāḥ nāḍyaḥ usannā bhavanti tāḥ
sām madhyemukhyaḥ tisraḥ iḍā piṃgalā suṣumṇā saṃjñā tatra suṣu
yāmuṃḍā
dhāra daṃḍa aṃtara vivara gata iti śiphābhyām tāsām madhye suṣumṇā
pādāṃguṣṭāt ārabhya pravṛtā vrahmaraṃdhra paryaṃtam śirasi vasthitā asti
śiphābhyām iti anuktau
tat labhyate iti tat uktam ekavaca
na eka aṃguṣṭāt eva tad lābhaḥ syāt iti dvivacanam sā iyam suṣumṇā
soma sūrya agni rūpiṇī bhavati tasyāḥ suṣumṇāyām adhyeviśa
saṃjñā nāḍī vartate tasyām eva hi padma sūtra nibham mṛṇāla taṃtu va
tparam sūkṣmam vrahmaraṃdhra nāmakam sthānam asti mūlādhāreṇa api ci
trā saṃjñā nāḍī saṃvaddhā asti
pare dvādaśa apare ṣoḍaśa
eṣā suṣumṇā aṃtargatā citrā nāḍī divya vastunā mṛtasya niḥ
raṇat dhārā tayā divya mārga padena abhidhīyate etat dvārāhi vrahma
raṃdhra acyutam amṛtam mā ānanda detu bhūtam prāṇinī śarīre praviśati
ḍāpiṃgalāt vārā śarīrāt vahi niryāti
nirgamāt ca āyuḥ ārogya nāśāt
thā niḥsaraṇam puṃsām vahis na bhavati tathā upāyaḥ tu śrī guroḥ yaḥ
tatra yadi iḍāyām caṃdra saṃcāraḥ tadā ava
śyā ādi ṣubha karmaṇām siddhiḥ piṃgalāyām sūrya saṃcāre krūra karma
siddhiḥ suṣumṇāyām caṃdra sūryyayoḥ ṛddharapi saṃcāre yadā bhavati
yaṃkālaḥ yoga abhyāse śubhaḥ bhavati eṣa vibhāgaḥ yoginā
m eva jñātum śakyaḥ na anyeṣām iti ṣa rātavatī ādeḥ arthaḥ
ḍalī sthānam upadarśayati ādhāra ityādinā pūrva ukta ādhārakam
trikoṇam maṃḍalam asti tatra supta ahi samāna ākārā
ḍalī śaktiḥ asti sā ca ātmānam paramātmānam vibharti tad saṃvarta
ddhā bhavati kena prakāreṇa tasyāḥ parameśvareṇa saha saṃvaṃdhitya
tra āha haṃsam iti haṃsaṃjīva ātmānam
tmānam ādāya suṣumṇā vartmanā vrahmaraṃdhram pratisamāgatā yatas
śaktiḥ eṣā bhavati tatas paramātma saṃgā iti vrahmaraṃdhram hi paramā
tma sthānam bhavati tatra saṃgatāyāḥ sutarām tad sthita saṃgatiḥ bha
vatī iti bhāvaḥ haṃsasya āśraya ādīn samupadarśayati haṃsityā
dinā prāṇa āśrayaḥ prāṇa vāyu samāśrayi ti arthaḥ prāṇa vāyu
stu nāḍīṣu samāśrayaḥ yasya iti evaṃbhūtaḥ sti katham nāḍī samāśrayaḥ
yasya prāṇa tvam prāṇasya iti atra āha ādhārāt ityādi tathā ca prayā
ti vahirdeśam iti prāṇa nāmatvam vāyum viśeṣaṇasya iti bhāvaḥ
prāṇaḥ hi nāḍīṣu saṃcarati iti uktyā sarva śarīra aṃtar saṃcāriṇī
tad vārā kuṃḍalī śaktiḥ api bhavatītiḥ dhvanyate dvādaśa aṃgulam ā
nena vahis prayāti iti atra vāma dakṣiṇa bhāgayoḥ iti śeṣaḥ
muktam taṃtra aṃtare bhojanam maithunam yuddham phala puṣpa graham tathā kuryāḥ
yātrā vivāhaka
rmāṇi śubha karmāṇi yāni vā tāni sarvāṇi kurvīta vāme
iti yoga abhyāsa kāram āha ramye ityādi
nā ramī iti aṃtena citta vikṣepa kārī ekānta deśaḥ bhidhīya
te vahu jana samākrāṃte kutsita vastu samākule
sya vikteyaḥ bhavati iti yoga abhyāsaḥ tatra na sambhavati iti tatyāgaḥ
kṛtaḥ āsanasya kaṭhora tve pi citta vikṣepaḥ syāt iti tat upe
yasya tu abhyāsa dārḍhyāt na citta vicchedaka tvam tam prati tu na idam
abhyanujñāyate ukta iṣu padmāsana ādi āsana paṃcakeṣu madhye kiṃcid
dāsanam avalaṃvya iti arthye vidhi ekam āsanam iti asya bhūtam japet
ti pṛthivī ādīni paṃcabhūtāni iḍayā piṃgalayā vanāḍyā vaham
tīti svabhāvaḥ
hanā teṣām siddhi ati tadā teṣām japaḥ bhavati iti bhāvaḥ
ye iti uktam tatra kosaubhūti audayakālī iti apekṣāyām āha daṃḍa iti ā
daṃḍa ākāra tayā prāṇadaṃḍam spṛśan ṛju tayā dvādaśa aṃgula
pravāhaḥ yadā vāyoḥ bhavati tadā bhūmeḥ udayaḥ jñeyaḥ prāṇa adhas bhā
gaṃ spṛśan adhas daśa aṃgulam vāyoḥ vahana kāle jalasya udayaḥ ghrā
bhāga spṛśan catur aṃgulam ūrddha mukham yadā vāyoḥ vahanam
prāṇasya vahis pārśvam spṛśan aṣṭa aṃgulam nirya
prāṇasya paritaḥ ca
tuḥ dikṣu spṛśan eva yadā madhye vahiti tadā tu ākāśa udayaḥ bhava
prasaṃgāt tad tad bhūta udayānām tad tad kāryeṣu viniyoga
mā ādarśayati dharaṇeḥ ityādinā a vyākhyāta prāyayā etat
ga svarūpam upadarśayati aṃgulībhiḥ ityādinā karaṇāni
idriyāṇi cakṣuḥ autra ghrāṇa mukha ātmakāni
thāsu alpasya api sva niḥsaraṇa mārgasya prāptau valavān vāyuḥke
na api mārgeṇa vahis niḥsarati indriyāṇā āyum upadyātam eva kuryā
